claims.claim: Direct America (imported used engine, i.e. Tokunbo)
claims.evidence: No import documents, customs sticker, or country-of-origin marking visible in the photo; origin cannot be confirmed from an image of the block alone.
Photo 0 shows visible dirt, oil residue, and surface rust/staining on the block and attachments.
No start-up video, compression test, or smoke/leak test shown; only a static photo on a bench.
No receipt, warranty card, or seller shop signage shown to confirm this promise is backed by anything.

risks.risk: Unknown exact engine code/displacement, so unclear which car it fits
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code stamp/casting number or ECU/VIN sticker
risks.if_unproven: price as a generic unidentified VVT-i unit, not matched to any specific model

risks.risk: Running condition and internal health (compression, bearings, timing chain) unknown despite 'tested ok' claim
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine starting, idling, and revving, plus a compression test reading
risks.if_unproven: price as non-running / needs full inspection, worst case

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (ECU, harness, turbo/sensors) uncertain; wiring seen disconnected
risks.proof: Photos of all included accessories laid out, especially ECU and full wiring harness
risks.if_unproven: price as incomplete, missing critical ancillaries

risks.risk: Hidden accident, flood, or overheating damage not visible in a single bench photo
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos including block casting, head gasket area, and coolant passages; any service history
risks.if_unproven: price as high-risk for hidden internal damage

risks.risk: Guarantee may be unenforceable or informal
risks.proof: Photo of a written/signed guarantee document or shop receipt with seller details
risks.if_unproven: price as if no guarantee exists

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/casting number for exact model identification
Video of the engine starting and running, including listening for knocks
Compression test results or a leak-down test clip
Photos of all included parts/accessories (ECU, harness, sensors) laid out
Written guarantee or receipt with seller/shop identification
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used Toyota VVT-i engine of unknown exact code and untested condition, so it can be priced at worst case (generic, unverified running condition, possibly incomplete) pending further proof.
